about: Original dark-fantasy sounds, synthesized from code by scripts/audio in the theforge monorepo. No samples or third-party recordings: royalty-free.

ui-click.about: A dull iron latch: buttons and menu items

ui-hover.about: A faint rune tick under the pointer

ui-back.about: A lower latch, falling: back and close

ui-wipe.about: The gilded iris closing and opening: a dark rush and a low thud

ui-error.about: A dissonant low buzz: not allowed

ui-confirm.about: A cold minor chime: a purchase, a reward, a solved puzzle

match-start.about: War horn and drums under a reverse swell: the battle begins

turn-yours.about: A single bell tolls: your turn

turn-foe.about: A muffled drum the dark breathes into: the enemy moves

end-turn.about: An iron gear ratchets and a stone seal drops

victory.about: Horns lift from minor to major over drums and choir: victory

defeat.about: A deep toll, a tritone choir and a wail sinking away: defeat

draw.about: Two bells that never resolve: a draw

strike.about: A blade through the air and a ringing bite: an attack

hit.about: A heavy blow lands: crunch and thud

death.about: The champion shatters and its soul wails away

card-draw.about: A card slides off the deck

card-play.about: A card slapped onto the stone table

summon.about: A unit takes the field: dark power sucks in and lands

spell.about: An arcane cast: a rising rush, cold glass and a growl beneath

relic.about: An iron relic clanks down and hums

power.about: A hero power charges and breaks loose

heal.about: Life returns: a pale rising chime

heartbeat.about: A slow heartbeat: your champion is near death (looped)

amb-hall.about: Valhalla: wind through the hall, crackling braziers, far thunder

amb-abyss.about: The Underworld: a lava rumble, bubbling, drips and far-off moans

menu.about: "Ashen Vigil": slow choir and strings over a drone, a tolling bell and a lone music box

battle-valhalla.about: "Blood Oath": war drums, low string ostinato, horns and choir (90 bpm)

battle-underworld.about: "Abyssal March": a heartbeat drum, a tritone ostinato, scraping metal and whispers (75 bpm)
